label: Cloud & Storage
description: File storage, object stores, key-value stores, gists and pastebins. AWS S3 and Backblaze B2 are intentionally omitted: SigV4 request signing and multi-step auth flows cannot be expressed as static headers in the http template runtime.

nodes.label: GitHub: Create Gist
nodes.description: Create a gist (single file) via the GitHub REST API.
nodes.search: github gist create snippet share code paste file upload

config.label: Public
config.help: true for a public gist, false for a secret one

credentials.help: Personal access token with the gist scope

nodes.label: GitHub: Get Gist
nodes.description: Fetch a gist (metadata and file contents) by ID via the GitHub REST API.
nodes.search: github gist get fetch read snippet code file download

credentials.help: Personal access token (public gists work with any valid token; secret gists need the gist scope)

nodes.label: Dropbox: Upload File
nodes.description: Upload text content to a file in Dropbox via /2/files/upload (content endpoint, Dropbox-API-Arg header + octet-stream body).
nodes.search: dropbox upload file save write put content storage cloud

config.label: Path
config.help: Destination path in Dropbox, starting with /

config.label: File content
config.help: Text content to upload as the file body

credentials.help: OAuth access token with files.content.write scope

nodes.label: Dropbox: List Folder
nodes.description: List the contents of a Dropbox folder via /2/files/list_folder.
nodes.search: dropbox list folder files directory browse contents storage

config.label: Folder path
config.help: Folder path starting with /; leave empty for the root folder

credentials.help: OAuth access token with files.metadata.read scope

nodes.label: Dropbox: Download File
nodes.description: Download a file's contents from Dropbox via /2/files/download (content endpoint; raw file bytes returned in body).
nodes.search: dropbox download file read get fetch content storage

credentials.help: OAuth access token with files.content.read scope

nodes.label: Google Drive: List Files
nodes.description: List files in Google Drive via the Drive v3 API, optionally filtered by a query.
nodes.search: google drive list files search folder documents storage cloud

config.label: Query
config.help: Drive search query (q parameter); leave empty to list all accessible files

credentials.help: OAuth 2.0 access token with a Drive scope (e.g. drive.readonly). This platform does not perform an OAuth flow — you must supply a valid, typically short-lived, user access token obtained externally (e.g. via Google's OAuth 2.0 Playground).

nodes.label: Google Drive: Get File Metadata
nodes.description: Look up a file or folder by ID and return its core metadata fields.
nodes.search: google drive get file folder metadata info name mimetype size link id lookup

config.label: File or Folder ID
config.help: Found in the Drive URL of the file or folder

credentials.help: OAuth 2.0 access token with a Drive scope. This platform does not perform an OAuth flow — you must supply a valid, typically short-lived, user access token obtained externally (e.g. via Google's OAuth 2.0 Playground).

nodes.label: Supabase Storage: Upload Object
nodes.description: Upload text content to a Supabase Storage bucket via the Storage API.
nodes.search: supabase storage upload object file bucket save write put

config.label: Project URL
config.help: Your Supabase project URL (no trailing slash)

config.label: Content
config.help: Text content to store as the object body

credentials.help: Service role key (secret; bypasses RLS) or an anon key permitted by your storage policies

nodes.label: Supabase Storage: List Objects
nodes.description: List objects in a Supabase Storage bucket, optionally under a prefix.
nodes.search: supabase storage list objects files bucket browse prefix

config.label: Project URL
config.help: Your Supabase project URL (no trailing slash)

config.label: Prefix
config.help: Folder prefix to list; leave empty for the bucket root

credentials.help: Service role key (secret; bypasses RLS) or an anon key permitted by your storage policies

nodes.label: Supabase: Select Rows
nodes.description: Query rows from a Supabase Postgres table via the PostgREST /rest/v1 API.
nodes.search: supabase postgres database select query rows read table postgrest

config.label: Project URL
config.help: Your Supabase project URL (no trailing slash)

config.label: Columns
config.help: PostgREST select list, e.g. * or id,name,created_at

config.label: Filter
config.help: Optional PostgREST filter query string, e.g. id=eq.1 or status=eq.done&limit=10 (appended verbatim)

credentials.help: Service role key (secret; bypasses RLS) or an anon key subject to your row-level-security policies

nodes.label: Supabase: Insert Row
nodes.description: Insert a row into a Supabase Postgres table via the PostgREST /rest/v1 API.
nodes.search: supabase postgres database insert row create record table write postgrest

config.label: Project URL
config.help: Your Supabase project URL (no trailing slash)

config.label: Row (JSON)
config.help: A JSON object of column values, sent verbatim as the request body

credentials.help: Service role key (secret; bypasses RLS) or an anon key subject to your row-level-security policies

nodes.label: Cloudflare KV: Write Key
nodes.description: Write a value to a Cloudflare Workers KV namespace key via the Cloudflare v4 API.
nodes.search: cloudflare kv key value write put store workers namespace cache

config.label: Account ID
config.help: Cloudflare account ID (dashboard → Workers & Pages → overview sidebar)

config.label: Namespace ID
config.help: KV namespace ID

credentials.help: API token with Workers KV Storage Edit permission

nodes.label: Cloudflare KV: Read Key
nodes.description: Read a value from a Cloudflare Workers KV namespace key via the Cloudflare v4 API (raw value returned in body).
nodes.search: cloudflare kv key value read get fetch workers namespace cache

config.label: Account ID
config.help: Cloudflare account ID

config.label: Namespace ID
config.help: KV namespace ID

credentials.help: API token with Workers KV Storage Read permission

nodes.label: File: Fetch Public URL
nodes.description: Fetch a file from any public URL — e.g. a public S3/GCS/R2 bucket object or a raw file link. Note: private S3 objects require SigV4 request signing, which is not supported by the http template runtime; only publicly readable URLs work here.
nodes.search: file fetch download url public s3 bucket object http get raw

config.label: URL
config.help: A publicly readable URL; no auth is sent

nodes.label: paste.rs: Create Paste
nodes.description: Create a paste on paste.rs (keyless); the paste URL is returned in the response body.
nodes.search: paste pastebin share text snippet create keyless simple
